hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Cote d'Ivoire and Sierra Leone || mostly flat to rolling coastal plains rising to rolling plateau and low mountains in northeast || facing the Atlantic Ocean, the coastline is characterized by lagoons, mangrove swamps, and river-deposited sandbars; the inland grassy plateau supports limited agriculture || Resources: iron ore, timber, diamonds, gold, hydropower || Exports: gold, ships, iron ore, rubber, refined petroleum (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat to rolling coastal plains rising to rolling plateau and low mountains in northeast || Western Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Cote d'Ivoire and Sierra Leone

climate.excerpt: tropical; hot, humid; dry winters with hot days and cool to cold nights; wet, cloudy summers with frequent heavy showers || dust-laden harmattan winds blow from the Sahara (December to March)

economy.excerpt: low-income West African economy; food scarcity, especially in rural areas; high poverty and inflation; bad recession prior to COVID-19 due to Ebola crisis; growing government debt; longest continuously operated rubber plantation; large informal economy || Exports: gold, ships, iron ore, rubber, refined petroleum (2023) || Industries: mining (iron ore and gold), rubber processing, palm oil processing, diamonds
